diaspora_bullets: SIVO.GO came from her own experience as a deaf cochlear implant user who felt anxious when travelling somewhere unfamiliar
Alerts come through colour-coded lights, screen symbols and haptic vibrations
hook_line: DEAF GRADUATE'S AI ALARM WINS UK JAMES DYSON AWARD

hook_stat.sub: Prize fund for SIVO.GO, the AI alarm for deaf users built by Gargi Agrawalla, UK winner of the James Dyson Award

news_summary: Gargi Agrawalla, a 23-year-old Loughborough University product design graduate born profoundly deaf, built SIVO.GO, an AI device that alerts deaf users to fire alarms, doorbells and knocks.
payoff: SIVO.GO remains a prototype, but the £5,000 funds reliability work, expanded user trials and steps toward certification and pilot manufacture.

stats.label: Sound samples used to train the AI model on the device itself
